text: 记者从上海海关了解到，今年前8个月，长三角地区实现进出口13.16万亿元人民币，比去年同期增长18.8%，占同期全国进出口总值的37.8%，规模创历史新高。围绕长三角外贸一体化高质量发展需求，长三角地区海关（包括上海、南京、杭州、宁波、合肥海关）持续创新构建政策支持体系。(新华社)
text_en: A reporter learned from Shanghai Customs that in the first eight months of this year, the Yangtze River Delta region achieved imports and exports of 13.16 trillion yuan, up 18.8% year-on-year, accounting for 37.8% of the national total for the period, setting a record high. To support the high-quality development of foreign trade integration in the Yangtze River Delta, customs in the region (including Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Ningbo, and Hefei customs) continue to innovate and build a policy support system. (Xinhua)
